name: Turkey Sausage & Spinach Scramble with Cauliflower Rice
description: Turkey sausage, spinach, and cauliflower rice scramble. AIP-leaning and diabetic-friendly.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Cook turkey sausage fully, crumble, and chill up to 4 days.
Steam or sauté cauliflower rice until just tender; chill.
Wash and chop spinach; store airtight.
Heat oil/ghee in a skillet.
Add cauliflower rice and sausage; cook 2–3 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Season and serve hot.

name: Grilled Chicken Salad with Cucumber & Olive Oil Vinaigrette
description: Lean grilled chicken over mixed greens with cucumber and olive oil–ACV dressing.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Grill multiple chicken breasts; chill 3–4 days.
Wash and dry greens; slice cucumbers.
Mix dressing (olive oil + vinegar); store bottled.
Slice 6 oz pre-cooked chicken.
Plate greens and cucumber; top with chicken.
Drizzle dressing; season and serve.

name: Pea Protein Shake (Blueberry Chia)
description: Pea protein shake with almond milk, blueberries, and chia seeds.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein
recipeIngredient: 1 scoop pea protein powder (~20 g protein)

itemListElement.text: Pre-portion blueberries + chia into small containers or bags.
Blend pea protein, almond milk, and pre-portioned pack until smooth.

name: Salmon with Roasted Broccoli & Cauliflower Mash
description: Baked salmon with roasted broccoli and buttery cauliflower mash.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Roast broccoli with olive oil, garlic, salt; chill.
Steam cauliflower; mash with ghee and salt; chill.
Pan-sear or bake salmon until cooked through.
Reheat broccoli and cauliflower mash; plate with salmon.

name: Smoked Salmon Cucumber Boats
description: Cucumber halves filled with dairy-free cream cheese and smoked salmon. Light, refreshing, and protein-rich breakfast.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Slice cucumbers lengthwise; scoop seeds to make boats. Store covered.
Portion smoked salmon into 2 oz servings.
Spread cream cheese into cucumber halves.
Top with smoked salmon and herbs.

name: Turkey Burger Patties with Sautéed Zucchini
description: Lean turkey patties served with garlic-sautéed zucchini. AIP-leaning and filling lunch.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Form turkey patties (season lightly with salt/herbs). Store in fridge 3 days or freeze.
Slice zucchini and store airtight.
Pan-sear turkey patties in oil until fully cooked (internal 165°F / 74°C).
Sauté zucchini with garlic and oil until tender.
Serve patties alongside zucchini.

name: Pea Protein Shake with Spinach & Strawberries
description: A green protein smoothie using pea protein, spinach, and strawberries.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein, smoothie
recipeIngredient: 1 scoop pea protein powder (~20 g protein)

itemListElement.text: Wash and portion strawberries + spinach into containers/bags.
Blend almond milk, pea protein, spinach, and strawberries until smooth.

name: Baked Cod with Lemon Asparagus & Cauliflower Mash
description: Oven-baked cod served with lemon asparagus and creamy cauliflower mash.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Steam and mash cauliflower with ghee; store.
Trim asparagus and store airtight.
Bake cod at 400°F (205°C) for 12–15 min until flaky.
Roast or sauté asparagus with olive oil; finish with lemon juice.
Reheat cauliflower mash; serve with cod and asparagus.

name: Turkey Bacon & Sautéed Kale with Avocado
description: Crispy turkey bacon served with garlicky sautéed kale and fresh avocado slices. High-protein AIP-friendly breakfast.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Wash, chop, and store kale in airtight container.
Slice avocados only day-of (to prevent browning).
Cook turkey bacon until crisp.
Sauté kale in olive oil with garlic powder until wilted.
Serve with fresh avocado slices.

name: Grilled Chicken with Green Beans & Garlic Olive Oil
description: Simple grilled chicken breast paired with green beans sautéed in garlic olive oil.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Grill multiple chicken breasts and refrigerate up to 4 days.
Wash and trim green beans.
Reheat or grill chicken breast until hot.
Sauté green beans in olive oil with garlic powder until tender-crisp.
Serve chicken with green beans.

name: Pea Protein Shake with Cocoa & Almond Butter
description: Protein-packed smoothie with pea protein, cocoa powder, and almond butter for richness.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein, smoothie
recipeIngredient: 1 scoop pea protein powder (~20 g protein)

itemListElement.text: Measure out cocoa and almond butter portions into containers for quick use.
Blend almond milk, protein powder, almond butter, and cocoa until smooth.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Brussels Sprouts & Cauliflower Rice Pilaf
description: Oven-roasted pork tenderloin paired with roasted Brussels sprouts and cauliflower rice pilaf.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Roast Brussels sprouts with olive oil, garlic powder, and salt; refrigerate.
Steam cauliflower rice, season, and store.
Roast or pan-sear pork tenderloin until internal temp reaches 145°F (63°C).
Reheat Brussels sprouts and cauliflower pilaf.
Serve together with pork slices.

name: Chicken Sausage with Sautéed Cabbage & Apple Slices
description: AIP-leaning breakfast of clean chicken sausage, tender cabbage, and crisp apple.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein
recipeIngredient: 4 oz chicken sausage (no sugar, no fillers)

itemListElement.text: Slice cabbage; store airtight up to 4 days.
Cook chicken sausage fully; chill up to 4 days.
Sauté cabbage in oil/ghee over medium heat 4–6 min until tender; season.
Reheat cooked sausage in the pan until hot.
Serve with fresh apple slices.

name: Grilled Tuna Steak with Cucumber Salad
description: Seared tuna steak served with a simple cucumber salad and olive oil dressing.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Slice cucumbers; store airtight 2–3 days.
Mix dressing: 2 tsp olive oil + 1 tsp ACV + pinch salt/herbs; bottle.
Heat grill or skillet; rub tuna with 1 tsp olive oil and salt.
Sear tuna 2–3 min per side (or to preferred doneness).
Toss cucumber with remaining oil and ACV dressing; serve with tuna.

name: Pea Protein Shake with Raspberries & Coconut Milk
description: Creamy pea protein smoothie using raspberries and light coconut milk.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein, smoothie
recipeIngredient: 1 scoop pea protein powder (~20 g protein)
3/4 cup light coconut milk (carton or diluted canned)

itemListElement.text: Portion raspberries into small containers; freeze or refrigerate.
Blend pea protein, coconut milk, raspberries, and ice (optional) until smooth.

name: Roast Beef with Roasted Carrots & Cauliflower Mash
description: Sliced roast beef served with oven-roasted carrots and creamy cauliflower mash.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein
recipeIngredient: 6 oz roast beef (leftover roast or deli-style, no sugar/gluten)

itemListElement.text: Roast carrots at 425°F (220°C) with 2 tsp olive oil, salt, and garlic; chill.
Steam cauliflower; mash with ghee and pinch salt; chill.
Slice roast beef and portion (if using a whole roast cooked on Sunday).
Reheat carrots and cauliflower mash.
Warm roast beef gently in a skillet with 1 tsp olive oil or in broth; serve with sides.

name: Turkey & Spinach Breakfast Patties with Steamed Broccoli
description: Homemade turkey patties with spinach, served alongside steamed broccoli for a hearty breakfast.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Mix ground turkey with spinach, salt, and herbs; form patties. Store raw (2–3 days) or freeze.
Wash and chop broccoli; store airtight.
Cook patties in skillet with oil until internal temp 165°F (74°C).
Steam broccoli until tender; season lightly.

name: Grilled Chicken Salad with Arugula & Lemon Olive Oil
description: Simple salad of grilled chicken breast, peppery arugula, and a lemony olive oil dressing.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Grill several chicken breasts and refrigerate 3–4 days.
Wash and dry arugula; store airtight.
Mix lemon juice and olive oil into dressing; refrigerate.
Slice pre-cooked chicken.
Toss arugula with dressing, season lightly, and top with chicken.

name: Pea Protein Shake with Blackberries & Chia
description: High-protein shake with pea protein, blackberries, chia seeds, and almond milk.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein, smoothie
recipeIngredient: 1 scoop pea protein powder (~20 g protein)

itemListElement.text: Portion blackberries and chia into containers or bags for quick blending.
Blend pea protein, almond milk, blackberries, and chia until smooth.

name: Grilled Lamb Chops with Roasted Zucchini & Cauliflower Mash
description: Tender lamb chops grilled and served with roasted zucchini and creamy cauliflower mash.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Roast zucchini with olive oil, salt, and herbs at 425°F (220°C) for 15 min; refrigerate.
Steam cauliflower; mash with ghee and salt; refrigerate.
Grill lamb chops 3–4 min per side (or to desired doneness).
Reheat roasted zucchini and cauliflower mash.
Serve together.

name: Chicken Apple Breakfast Hash
description: Ground chicken sautéed with apples and shredded cabbage for a savory-sweet, protein-rich breakfast.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Dice apples and store in water + lemon juice for up to 2 days.
Shred cabbage and store airtight.
Heat oil/ghee in skillet. Cook ground chicken until browned.
Add cabbage and apple; sauté until tender. Season with cinnamon and salt.

name: Grilled Shrimp Salad with Spinach & Avocado
description: Juicy grilled shrimp on a bed of spinach, avocado, and olive oil–lemon dressing.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Wash and dry spinach; store airtight.
Prepare lemon-olive oil dressing; refrigerate.
Grill shrimp 2–3 min per side until opaque.
Slice avocado fresh.
Assemble spinach, avocado, and shrimp. Drizzle dressing.

name: Pea Protein Shake with Spinach & Blueberries
description: Smoothie with pea protein, spinach, blueberries, and almond milk.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein, smoothie
recipeIngredient: 1 scoop pea protein powder (~20 g protein)

itemListElement.text: Portion blueberries and spinach into small containers for smoothies.
Blend pea protein, almond milk, spinach, and blueberries until smooth.

name: Grilled Chicken Thighs with Roasted Brussels Sprouts & Garlic Cauliflower Mash
description: Juicy grilled chicken thighs served with roasted Brussels sprouts and garlic cauliflower mash.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Roast Brussels sprouts with olive oil and salt at 425°F (220°C); refrigerate.
Steam cauliflower; mash with ghee, garlic powder, and salt; refrigerate.
Grill chicken thighs until internal temp 165°F (74°C).
Reheat Brussels sprouts and cauliflower mash.
Serve together.

name: Turkey Breakfast Scramble with Kale & Mushrooms
description: Ground turkey sautéed with kale and mushrooms for a savory, high-protein breakfast.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Wash and chop kale; store airtight.
Slice mushrooms; store airtight.
Cook turkey in skillet with oil until browned.
Add mushrooms and kale; sauté until tender. Season with salt and garlic.

name: Baked Salmon Salad with Mixed Greens & Avocado
description: Flaky baked salmon served cold on greens with avocado and olive oil dressing.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Bake salmon at 400°F (205°C) for 12–15 min until flaky; cool and refrigerate.
Wash and dry greens; store airtight.
Slice avocado fresh.
Assemble greens, salmon, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil + lemon.

name: Pea Protein Shake with Cocoa & Coconut Milk
description: Chocolate-style protein shake made with pea protein, unsweetened cocoa, and coconut milk.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein, smoothie
recipeIngredient: 1 scoop pea protein powder (~20 g protein)

itemListElement.text: Pre-portion cocoa powder into small container.
Blend pea protein, coconut milk, and cocoa until smooth.
Add ice if desired.

name: Grilled Steak with Garlic Green Beans & Cauliflower Rice
description: Juicy grilled steak paired with garlic green beans and cauliflower rice.
keywords: gluten-free, soy-free, egg-free, lactose-free, AIP, diabetic-friendly, high-protein

itemListElement.text: Steam cauliflower rice until tender; refrigerate.
Trim and wash green beans; store airtight.
Grill steak to desired doneness; rest before slicing.
Sauté green beans in olive oil with garlic until tender.
Reheat cauliflower rice; serve with steak and beans.
